verdict.rationale: The MI355X ships with a substantial software ecosystem (ROCm, AMD SMI, GPU Operator, Device Metrics Exporter), so a machine-readable API spec is a fair question and the axis applies. The probe found no OpenAPI or Swagger file at any candidate path on the ROCm docs site, and no evidence describes an equivalent downloadable spec. The llms.txt file is a documentation index for LLMs, not an API specification, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
